17-1418-2226.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
17-1418-2226.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Virtue of Knowledge.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Lava Zombie by paying its mana cost.
When Lava Zombie enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

1558-3756-3875-4231-7810.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-3756-3875-4231-7810.description:
Play Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Tippy-Toe.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more oil counters on it

1987-3120-6991.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-3120-6991.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Donnie & April.
When Donnie & April enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-3120-6991.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1676-4050-6972.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Boss's Chauffeur.
When Boss's Chauffeur dies, its persist ability and second ability trigger.
Resolve the second trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Citizen creature tokens equal to the number of +1/+1 counters that were on Boss's Chauffeur.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Boss's Chauffeur from your graveyard to the battlefield. It'll enter with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the number of creatures you control minus 1 due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

1308-1558-3147-3875-4231.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1308-1558-3147-3875-4231.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Anointed Procession.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

3835-6867-7042.description:
Cast Appa by paying {2}{W}{W}.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Appa.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {0}.
Appa triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Appa.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

647-4153-6575--136.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, copying another nonlegendary Saga you control and putting two to three lore counters on it.
The Saga tokens first through fourth chapter abilities trigger, as applicable. Resolve all triggers, and sacrifice the Saga token upon resolving the final trigger.
When the Saga token leaves the battlefield, Resourceful Defense triggers, moving the lore counters from the Saga token onto Esper Terra.
Esper Terra's second, third and fourth chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the second and third chapter abilities.
Resolve the fourth chapter ability, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G} and then exiling Esper Terra and returning it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
Resourceful Defense and Terra, Magical Adept trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, moving all counters from Esper Terra onto any other permanent
Resolve the Terra, Magical Adept trigger, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
647-4153-6575--136.notes: The chosen Saga must have no more than four chapter abilities. Once you have infinite white mana, you can instead copy any other permanent besides the chosen Saga, and move counters to and from Esper Terra using Resourceful Defense's ability.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-617-5139.description:
Activate Relic of Sauron by tapping it, adding two in any combination of {U}, {B} and/or {R}.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Relic of Sauron.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Voltaic Key.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Relic of Sauron.
Repeat.

2781-3908.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Spark Double.
2781-3908.description:
Cast Spark Double by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian
When Spark Double enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Spark Double. Choose to have Spark Double enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.

1-1742-5796-6282.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
You have a card in hand.
Your life total is at least 2.
1-1742-5796-6282.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Containment Construct triggers, exiling the discarded card with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Starving Revenant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

117-185-2501-3098-4377.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U} on the first turn, with at most {7}{U}{U}{U} available each other extra turn
117-185-2501-3098-4377.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature with power two or greater.
You have not cast an instant or sorcery this turn.
117-185-2501-3098-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U} and sacrificing a creature with power two or greater, targeting yourself.
Walk the Aeons's casualty ability and Talrand trigger.
Resolve the Walk the Aeons trigger, copying it, targeting yourself.
Resolve the Talrand trigger, creating a 2/2 Drake creature token.
Resolve both Walk the Aeonss, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your last extra turn.
Cast Call to Mind by paying {2}{U} and sacrificing a Drake, targeting Mystic Retrieval.
Call to Mind's casualty ability and Talrand trigger.
Resolve the Call to Mind trigger, copying it, targeting Walk the Aeons.
Resolve the Talrand trigger, creating a 2/2 Drake creature token.
Resolve both Call to Minds, returning Walk the Aeons and Mystic Retrieval from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat steps 1 through 6 one additional time.
Cast Mystic Retrieval by paying {3}{U} and sacrificing a Drake, targeting Call to Mind.
Mystic Retrieval's casualty ability and Talrand trigger.
Resolve the Mystic Retrieval trigger, copying it, targeting Walk the Aeons.
Resolve the Talrand trigger, creating a 2/2 Drake creature token.
Resolve both Mystic Retrievals, returning Walk the Aeons and Call to Mind from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat steps 1 through 6 one additional time.
Repeat from step 7.

215-391-2404-3464.notablePrerequisites:
Blossom Dryad does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three other creatures.
215-391-2404-3464.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout to your hand.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters, it triggers itself, untapping Blossom Dryad.
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite green mana, you may activate Temur Sabertooth any number of times and recast any creatures castable with green mana any number of times, effectively "blinking" your green creatures any number of times.
You may also activate Blossom Dryad any number of times.

2292-3565-4424.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one blue card in hand.
2292-3565-4424.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dragon's Eye Savants.
When Dragon's Eye Savants dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Dragon's Eye Savants from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Dragon's Eye Savants's morph ability by revealing a blue card from your hand, turning it face up.
Repeat.

3398-4689-5231.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
You have at least six experience counters.
3398-4689-5231.description:
Declare Otharri and Hellkite Charger as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Otharri trigger, causing you to get an experience counter and create at least seven 2/2 Rebel creature tokens that are tapped and attacking.
Activate Thermopod's second ability seven times by sacrificing seven Rebels, adding {5}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures you control and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

862-2173-4050-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Crimson Kobolds from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

239-1912-3099-3767.notablePrerequisites: You control a Sliver that does not have summoning sickness.
239-1912-3099-3767.description:
Activate any Sliver by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate the tapped Sliver by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have a large amount of mana, you may use it to activate Leyline of Abundance, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.

2558-4385-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {2}, creating a 1/1 Sliver creature token.
The Sliver token enters the battlefield, triggering Sword of the Meek, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching itself to the Sliver token.
Repeat.
